answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The mirror is the island, the mesa the endorsement that crosses it, and the basalt the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one mirror is cheap to hold, but a mesa only counts when no basalt exists, and that takes independent history.
